changelog:
huawei-cloud-swr-image-automation 1.0.0

- Initial release providing automation for Huawei Cloud SWR cross-region image sync and trigger management via hcloud CLI.
- Supports configuring auto and manual image sync, managing sync jobs and triggers, and querying sync target regions.
- Includes safety features: all write operations require explicit user confirmation, with commands and risks clearly displayed.
- Enforces best practices for credential, security, and IAM permission requirements.
- Provides guidance for handling common permission errors and workflow for parameter confirmation.
summary: Huawei Cloud SWR (Software Repository for Container) image automation and operations skill using hcloud CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) configure cross-region image sync (auto or manual), (2) manage SWR triggers for auto-deploy to CCE/CCI, (3) query available sync target regions, (4) check sync job status, (5) create/update/delete trigger configurations. Trigger: user mentions "SWR automation", "SWR 自动化", "镜像同步", "SWR sync", "跨区域同步", "cross-region sync", "触发器", "SWR trigger", "自动部署", "auto deploy", "镜像复制", "image replication", "SWR 触发器"
